profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Founding Engineer | Ruby on Rails · React · AI Integration

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Founding Engineer, I was instrumental in building our SaaS project management platform from the ground up, from early architectural decisions to a fully functioning product used by event coordinators to streamline and manage their events.
Over the past 6 years, I have led the technical development of the platform, designing and engineering core features across the full stack using Ruby on Rails, React Redux, and PostgreSQL. I also architected and implemented real-time communication capabilities leveraging Pub/Sub, delivering a seamless live chat experience for users.
Most recently, I have been integrating AI-powered features into the platform, enhancing the user experience and bringing intelligent automation to event coordination workflows.
Transitioning from a Senior Software Engineer background at previous companies, I brought that experience to bear in shaping the foundation of this platform, making key technology choices, establishing development standards, and continuously evolving the product to meet the needs of a growing user base.
